candidates.change_summary: Change the return expression to its negation, so the function returns the opposite boolean.
Replace the lookup in the mapping with a constant 'true', making the function always return true.
Replace the lookup in the mapping with a constant 'false', making the function always return false.
Replace the approval mapping update from _status to !_status, so setting a logger to true actually sets it to false and vice versa.
Replace the assignment with a function call that always sets the mapping to true, ignoring the _status parameter.
Replace the assignment so it sets the mapping to false regardless of the _status parameter.
Remove the assignment statement entirely, so the mapping is never updated.
Replace the mapping key from _logger to address(0), so only address(0) is ever modified.
Remove the onlyOwner modifier from the setApprovedLogger function, allowing any caller to modify the mapping.
Replace the approval assignment line with an unconditional assignment of false, so that setApprovedLogger always disables the logger.
Replace the approval assignment with an unconditional assignment of true, so that setApprovedLogger always enables the logger ignoring the _status parameter.
Change the onlyOwner modifier to always revert, making any call to setApprovedLogger fail.
